Powerhouse requires leadership, agility and discipline 
in a complex and dynamic marketplace. At Hershey, we

requires significant, smart and exciting transformations

success is the focus we have on our most material risks, 
opportunities and how we hold ourselves to the highest 
integrity, quality and safety standards.
